name: Calcular el porcentaje de victorias de un equipo deportivo (Caso 1)
untr_name: Calculating the Winning Percentage of a Sports Team (Case 1)
description: Construya un programa que reciba del usuario el numero de partidos que un equipo deportivo gano en un torneo de 12 partidos y calcule el porcentaje de victorias de ese equipo. El programa debe pedir el numero de partidos ganados hasta que el usuario introduzca un numero valido.
untr_description: Construct a program that receives from the user the number of games that a sports team won in a tournament of 12 games and calculates the winning percentage of that sports team. The program must ask for the number of the games won until the user enters a valid number.

comments.content: Esta linea declara e inicializa una variable entera llamada `totalGames` con el valor 12.

comments.untr_content: The purpose of this line is to store the total number of games played in the tournament, which is a constant value in this context.

comments.untr_content: By using a variable for the total number of games, you make the code more readable and maintainable. If the number of games changes in the future, you only need to update this line.

comments.untr_content: A common misconception might be to hard-code the number 12 directly in calculations later in the program. Using a variable instead helps avoid magic numbers, which are numbers used directly in code without explanation.

comments.content: La sintaxis 'scan.close();' llama al metodo 'close' en el objeto 'scan'. Este metodo es parte de la clase Scanner y se usa para cerrar el flujo de entrada asociado con el Scanner.
comments.untr_content: The syntax 'scan.close();' calls the 'close' method on the 'scan' object. This method is part of the Scanner class and is used to close the input stream associated with the Scanner.

comments.content: Una idea equivocada comun es que cerrar el Scanner es opcional. Aunque el programa puede ejecutarse sin cerrarlo, es buena practica cerrar cualquier flujo de E/S cuando ya no es necesario.
comments.untr_content: A common misconception is that closing the Scanner is optional. While the program may run without closing it, it's a best practice to close any I/O streams when they are no longer needed.

comments.content: Ten cuidado: si intentas usar el objeto 'scan' despues de cerrarlo, encontrarias una IllegalStateException. Asegurate de que todas las operaciones de entrada necesarias se completen antes de cerrar el Scanner.
comments.untr_content: Be cautious: if you try to use the 'scan' object after closing it, you will encounter an IllegalStateException. Ensure that all necessary input operations are completed before closing the Scanner.

comments.content: Esta linea calcula la relacion de partidos ganados respecto al numero total de partidos, que es la logica central para determinar el porcentaje de victorias.
comments.untr_content: This line calculates the ratio of games won to the total number of games, which is the core logic for determining the winning percentage.

comments.content: La expresion `(double) wins / totalGames` convierte el entero `wins` a un double para asegurar que la operacion de division resulte en un numero de punto flotante, permitiendo un calculo mas preciso de la relacion.
comments.untr_content: The expression `(double) wins / totalGames` casts the integer `wins` to a double to ensure that the division operation results in a floating-point number, allowing for a more precise calculation of the ratio.

comments.content: Una idea equivocada comun podria ser realizar una division entera, lo que truncaria la parte decimal y conduciria a resultados incorrectos. Al convertir `wins` a double, evitas este problema.
comments.untr_content: A common misconception might be to perform integer division, which would truncate the decimal part and lead to incorrect results. By casting `wins` to a double, you avoid this issue.

comments.content: Es buena practica asegurarse de que al menos uno de los operandos en una operacion de division sea un numero de punto flotante cuando necesitas un resultado preciso, ya que esto previene una division entera no intencionada.
comments.untr_content: It's a best practice to ensure that at least one operand in a division operation is a floating-point number when you need a precise result, as this prevents unintended integer division.

comments.content: Estas creando una instancia de la clase DecimalFormat para formatear la salida del porcentaje de victorias. Esta linea es crucial para asegurar que el porcentaje se muestre con hasta tres decimales, haciendo la salida mas legible y precisa.

distractors.description: Podrias elegir este distractor si crees erroneamente que el rango valido para wins deberia excluir tanto 0 como el numero total de partidos. Esta linea usa incorrectamente los operadores '<=' y '>=' , lo que impediria que el usuario ingrese 0 o 12 como entradas validas, a pesar de que son resultados legitimos (por ejemplo, perder todos los partidos o ganar todos los partidos). Usar este distractor haria que el programa rechace entradas validas, provocando un bucle infinito si el usuario intenta ingresar 0 o 12. El problema clave aqui es la mala comprension del rango valido de entradas, que deberia incluir tanto 0 como el numero total de partidos.
distractors.untr_description: You might choose this distractor if you mistakenly believe that the valid range for wins should exclude both 0 and the total number of games. This line incorrectly uses '<=' and '>=' operators, which would prevent the user from entering 0 or 12 as valid inputs, even though these are legitimate outcomes (e.g., losing all games or winning all games). Using this distractor would cause the program to reject valid inputs, leading to an infinite loop if the user tries to input 0 or 12. The key issue here is the misunderstanding of the valid range of inputs, which should include both 0 and the total number of games.

distractors.description: Este distractor puede parecer correcto si piensas que ambas condiciones (wins menor que 0 y mayor que el total de partidos) deben ser verdaderas al mismo tiempo para que la entrada sea invalida. Sin embargo, esto es logicamente imposible porque un numero no puede ser simultaneamente menor que 0 y mayor que 12. Como resultado, esta condicion nunca seria verdadera, y el bucle no funcionaria como se pretende, permitiendo que entradas invalidas pasen sin ser verificadas. La idea equivocada aqui es sobre como funcionan los operadores logicos, especificamente la diferencia entre '&&' (y) y '||' (o).
distractors.untr_description: This distractor might seem correct if you think that both conditions (wins being less than 0 and greater than the total number of games) need to be true at the same time for the input to be invalid. However, this is logically impossible because a number cannot be both less than 0 and greater than 12 simultaneously. As a result, this condition would never be true, and the loop would not function as intended, allowing invalid inputs to pass through unchecked. The misconception here is about how logical operators work, specifically the difference between '&&' (and) and '||' (or).

distractors.description: Podrias pensar que dividir dos enteros te dara automaticamente un resultado decimal, pero en Java dividir dos enteros resulta en una division entera, que trunca la parte decimal. Esto significa que si usas esta linea, la relacion siempre sera cero a menos que el numero de victorias sea igual al numero total de partidos. Esto ocurre porque la division de dos enteros en Java da como resultado un entero, no un double. Para obtener un resultado decimal correcto, necesitas asegurarte de que al menos uno de los operandos sea un double.
distractors.untr_description: You might think that dividing two integers will automatically give you a decimal result, but in Java, dividing two integers results in integer division, which truncates the decimal part. This means if you use this line, the ratio will always be zero unless the number of wins equals the total number of games. This is because the division of two integers in Java results in an integer, not a double. To get a correct decimal result, you need to ensure at least one of the operands is a double.

distractors.description: Podrias pensar que convertir el resultado de la division a double te dara el valor decimal correcto. Sin embargo, la division dentro de los parentesis se realiza primero, y dado que tanto 'wins' como 'totalGames' son enteros, esto resulta en una division entera. El resultado se convierte despues a double, pero para ese momento la informacion decimal ya se ha perdido. Esto significa que la relacion sera cero a menos que 'wins' sea igual a 'totalGames'. Para obtener el resultado correcto, necesitas asegurarte de que la propia division se realice con al menos un operando de tipo double.
distractors.untr_description: You might think that casting the result of the division to a double will give you the correct decimal value. However, the division inside the parentheses is performed first, and since both 'wins' and 'totalGames' are integers, this results in integer division. The result is then cast to a double, but by that point, the decimal information is already lost. This means the ratio will be zero unless 'wins' equals 'totalGames'. To get the correct result, you need to ensure the division itself is performed with at least one double operand.
